verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant you can delegate work to. It offers AI Chats with notes passed as context, answers grounded in your notes, multi-step planning, and proposed creates and updates that you approve. It also handles block-level translate, rewrite and summarize tasks, property auto-fill, auto-tagging and image analysis, and the AI assistant appears as a feature on the pricing page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works well in practice, and deeper documentation of how multi-step plans run and how far the assistant can act beyond proposing changes for approval.
